decision: Build one new pure module src/core/role-criticality.ts — zero IO, zero migration, zero new authority store — owning the frozen RoleCriticality record (the T-0044 seam) and a family of total, deterministic functions that fold a role's already-fetched Grant[] into the three signed D-A=A3 bits + a derived level. axis a (approve_or_transition) = an effective grant with operation in {approve, transition} (grant-lattice Operation set + isEffective); axis b (external_invoke) = the exact T-0034 predicate resourceType==='effect_resource' AND operation==='invoke' on an effective grant; axis c (sensitive_read) = deriveClearance(effective read grants, nowMs) (imported from data-classification.ts, constraint-first) compared against a single named SENSITIVE_READ_THRESHOLD: DataClass = 'confidential' whose rank is read off the frozen DATA_CLASS_ORDER. DataClass/deriveClearance are imported (never redeclared); Grant/Operation/ResourceType/isEffective are imported. DB access is deferred behind an injected port RoleGrantSource.getRoleGrants(tenantId, roleId): Promise<Grant[]> (mirrors GrantSource/ClassificationSource/EffectSource; Postgres DAO → T-0053). No migration, no new table, no new column: role_criticality is a pure computation over existing rows (derived-not-stored, spec §6-B). A new structural fitness gate ci/checks/role-criticality-isolation.sh (banned-token + no-IO-import + no-Date.now + export-seam + frozen-foundation + no-migration) is appended to npm run fitness. The gate/diff-application/audit are deliberately left to the consumer T-0044 — T-0040 owns ONLY the computation, the record shape, and criticalityDiff.

rejected_alternatives.option: Materialize role_criticality as a grant/role column or a new role_criticality table (+ migration 030)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Duplicates authority state already living in grant + data_classification (violates rights-derived-only, NF-2) and forces a write-path re-derivation hook on every grant/classification change — strictly worse than recompute-on-read. Spec §6-B rules it out; materialization is a T-0053 concern only if perf ever demands it.

rejected_alternatives.option: A second 'criticality' authority algebra (critFlags/criticalityAcl/field-visibility token computed independently of grants)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: A parallel authority subsystem that drifts from the grant table — the exact anti-pattern data-classification-isolation.sh / effect-resource-isolation.sh ban. Every bit MUST derive from Grant rows + DataClass only (NF-2).

rejected_alternatives.option: Recompute the three bits independently inside T-0044
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Splits the source of truth: the gate and the computation could diverge silently. FR-7 fixes the seam — T-0040 owns the computation + record + criticalityDiff; T-0044 consumes them and must not recompute.

rejected_alternatives.option: Inline the fold into grant-resolver.ts (no separate module)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Couples the resolver to the criticality contract + the T-0044 diff helper, bloating its boundary and forcing an edit to a near-frozen hot file. A separate pure module keeps the seam self-contained and re-importable by T-0044 (same reasoning T-0034 used for effect-resource.ts).

rejected_alternatives.option: Let the core call Date.now() / read clearance via a field-name lookup
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Breaks purity/determinism (NF-1/NF-7): nowMs is a parameter so equal inputs ⇒ equal output. Clearance rides on the existing opaque grant.constraint marker via deriveClearance (T-0033 constraint-first) — no field-ACL store, no Grant schema change.

rejected_alternatives.option: deriveClearance over ALL grants (not just read grants)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Axis (c) is specifically read of sensitive data above a threshold. Filtering Ge to operation==='read' before deriveClearance keeps a clearance marker sitting on a non-read grant from raising the read-sensitivity bit (AC-9).

fields.name: approve_or_transition
fields.type: boolean — axis a: effective grant with operation in {approve, transition}

fields.name: external_invoke
fields.type: boolean — axis b: effective resourceType==='effect_resource' AND operation==='invoke'

fields.name: sensitive_read
fields.type: boolean — axis c: deriveClearance(effective read grants) rank >= rank(SENSITIVE_READ_THRESHOLD)

fields.name: level
fields.type: RoleCriticalityLevel — 'critical' iff any axis true (the single-approver carveout)

fields.name: expanded
fields.type: { approve_or_transition: boolean; external_invoke: boolean; sensitive_read: boolean } — bit expanded iff to===true && from===false

fields.name: escalates
fields.type: boolean — to.level==='critical' && from.level!=='critical' (routine→critical; ≡ any expanded bit)

fields.name: getRoleGrants
fields.type: (tenantId: string, roleId: string) => Promise<Grant[]> — grants pre-scoped to one tenant; the function does no IO

fields.name: value
fields.type: DataClass = 'confidential' — day-1 threshold, tunable within the closed DataClass axis (FR-4, spec §7)

contracts: export interface RoleCriticality { approve_or_transition: boolean; external_invoke: boolean; sensitive_read: boolean; level: RoleCriticalityLevel; }
export interface RoleGrantSource { getRoleGrants(tenantId: string, roleId: string): Promise<Grant[]>; }
export function combineCriticality(grants: Grant[], nowMs: number): RoleCriticality; // PURE, sync, no IO — the atomic fold
export function roleCriticality(source: RoleGrantSource, tenantId: string, roleId: string, nowMs: number): Promise<RoleCriticality>; // only async/IO-bearing seam (via port)
export function criticalityLevel(c: { approve_or_transition: boolean; external_invoke: boolean; sensitive_read: boolean }): RoleCriticalityLevel;
export interface CriticalityDiff { expanded: { approve_or_transition: boolean; external_invoke: boolean; sensitive_read: boolean }; escalates: boolean; }
export function criticalityDiff(from: RoleCriticality, to: RoleCriticality): CriticalityDiff;
import { Grant, Operation, isEffective } from "./grant-lattice"; // imported, not redeclared
import { DataClass, DATA_CLASS_ORDER, deriveClearance } from "./data-classification"; // imported, not redeclared

fitness_functions.rule: No second authority store: role-criticality.ts contains no parallel-authority token (_acl, criticalityRights, critFlags, criticalityAcl, field_visibility, fieldVisibility) in non-comment code — every bit derives from Grant rows + DataClass only (NF-2, AC-15).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/role-criticality-isolation.sh — banned-token grep with comment lines excluded; wired into `npm run fitness` (and thus `npm run ci`).

fitness_functions.rule: Purity / no IO: role-criticality.ts imports no pg/fs/net/http; DB access only via the injected RoleGrantSource port (NF-1, AC-15).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/role-criticality-isolation.sh — forbidden-import grep (mirror of data-classification-isolation.sh DC9 / effect-resource-isolation.sh ER-ISO2).

fitness_functions.rule: No Date.now in core: role-criticality.ts contains no `Date.now(` / `new Date(` — nowMs is a parameter (determinism, NF-7/FR-6).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/role-criticality-isolation.sh — grep for `Date.now(` and `new Date(` in non-comment code.

fitness_functions.rule: T-0044 export seam: the module exports RoleCriticality, RoleCriticalityLevel, RoleGrantSource, roleCriticality, combineCriticality, criticalityLevel, criticalityDiff, SENSITIVE_READ_THRESHOLD; DataClass/deriveClearance are imported from data-classification.ts (not redeclared) (FR-9, AC-18).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/role-criticality-isolation.sh — assert each export symbol present + assert an `import ... from "./data-classification"` line + assert NO local `type DataClass` redeclaration; plus tsc --noEmit in `npm run ci`.

fitness_functions.rule: Frozen foundation (byte-level): the commit does not edit grant-lattice.ts, data-classification.ts, effect-resource.ts, grant-resolver.ts, object-handle.ts, or any migrations/*.sql (NF-5, AC-16).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/role-criticality-isolation.sh — `git diff --name-only <base>...HEAD` fails if any frozen path appears; plus tsc --noEmit.

fitness_functions.rule: No migration / tenant-table set unchanged: no new migrations/*.sql added; ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt byte-unchanged; the cross-tenant fitness set unchanged (derived, not stored) (NF-6, AC-17).

fitness_functions.rule: Bit-derivation + threshold carveout + level/diff + effective-window + fail-closed unknown-op + determinism hold (the 14 behavioural ACs).
fitness_functions.ci_check: src/__tests__/role-criticality.test.ts (vitest, `npm test`) — one assertion per AC-1..AC-14.

runtime_target: локально (library code) — in-process pure TS, no runtime of its own; executes wherever the resolver/T-0044 gate runs (Choros app process). No external resource, no migration ⇒ no founder gate (GT-4). Postgres RoleGrantSource DAO deferred to T-0053.
